name: crescent moon pose
description: Stand and arch sideways with arms overhead to lengthen one side of the body. It opens the ribs, sides and shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and raise your arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips and keep your hips level.
Lean your upper body slowly to one side in a gentle curve.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths without twisting forward or back.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
